notes:
Summary: KeelPoint is a mid-enterprise CCaaS provider looking to add a lightweight RAG layer for ticket deflection and agent assist. Primary constraint: tight latency SLOs for support flows + predictable cost per query. They want embeddings + a neural reranker in the hot path (candidate generator -> embed + ANN -> rerank top 20 -> return top 5).

Scale & targets:
- Corpus: 12M-18M canonical passages (docs split into passages ~250-400 tokens).
- QPS: baseline 200 qps, peak 1k qps during business hours (US-centric).
- Latency SLO (customer-visible): p95 < 120ms, p99 < 220ms for search+rerank combined. Prefers tail SLAs.
- Top-5 quality target: precision@5 > 0.90 on KeelPoint internal eval set; reranker must lift top-5 relevance by >=15% vs BM25.
- Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost per query <= $0.02 (embeddings + ANN + rerank amortized).

Model preferences & architecture notes:
- Candidate stage: compact embedding model (open model preferred) driving ANN index. Considering 1536-d static embeddings or 768-d quantized to save footprint.
- Reranker: 3B-ish reranker (FP16/4-bit option). Rerank in memory for top 20 to meet latency.
- Want routing fallback: high-cost reranker on peak fallback to cheap re-ranker + cached results.

Security / compliance: Keystone asks for SSO/SAML, SOC2 + written audit logging, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency for EMEA clients. Legal wants a data handling appendix before any POC with live PII.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- VP Eng: "If we can't guarantee p99 latency we'll lose the use case - agents need answers within 250ms or they won't adopt."
- Head of Platform: "We're open to dedicated pools if it keeps costs predictable; public-hosted wildcards are risky for volume spikes."

POC ask: 4-week technical pilot. Deliverables: indexing 15M passages, run 7-day steady-state 200 qps + 24-hour 1k qps soak, produce latency/cost report, and run A/B eval vs BM25 + current Elastic config. Engineerable success metric = precision@5 + p99 latency.
